CREATE TABLE policies (
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	environment VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	risk risk_level NOT NULL, 
	rules JSONB NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name, version), 
	CHECK (version >= 1)
)

CREATE TABLE resources (
	provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	external_id VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	environment VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	labels JSONB NOT NULL, 
	managed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (provider, external_id)
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	username VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	role user_role NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (username)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
	resource_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	source event_source NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	dedup_window TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	severity severity NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	raw_payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_event_dedup UNIQUE (source, resource_id, fingerprint, dedup_window), 
	FOREIGN KEY(resource_id) REFERENCES resources (id)
)

CREATE TABLE incidents (
	resource_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	correlation_key VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	state incident_state NOT NULL, 
	severity severity NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	retry_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	approval_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	resolved_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (version >= 1 AND attempts >= 0 AND retry_limit >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(resource_id) REFERENCES resources (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_active_incident ON incidents (correlation_key) WHERE state NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'ESCALATED', 'ROLLEDBACK')

CREATE TABLE resource_locks (
	resource_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	token UUID NOT NULL, 
	acquired_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (resource_id), 
	CHECK (expires_at > acquired_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(resource_id) REFERENCES resources (id), 
	UNIQUE (token)
)

CREATE TABLE anomaly_scores (
	resource_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	incident_id UUID, 
	model_version VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	window_start TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	window_end TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	anomalous BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	features JSONB NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (resource_id, model_version, window_start, window_end), 
	CHECK (window_end > window_start), 
	FOREIGN KEY(resource_id) REFERENCES resources (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(incident_id) REFERENCES incidents (id)
)

CREATE TABLE audit_entries (
	sequence BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, 
	incident_id UUID, 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	details JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(incident_id) REFERENCES incidents (id)
)

CREATE TABLE diagnoses (
	incident_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	root_cause VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	evidence_ids JSONB NOT NULL, 
	reasoning JSONB NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(incident_id) REFERENCES incidents (id)
)

CREATE TABLE evidence_items (
	incident_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	content JSONB NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(incident_id) REFERENCES incidents (id)
)

CREATE TABLE incident_events (
	incident_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	event_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	linked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (incident_id, event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(incident_id) REFERENCES incidents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES events (id)
)

CREATE TABLE model_invocations (
	incident_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	prompt_version VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	request JSONB NOT NULL, 
	response JSONB NOT NULL, 
	latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (latency_ms >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(incident_id) REFERENCES incidents (id)
)

CREATE TABLE remediation_plans (
	incident_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	diagnosis_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	risk risk_level NOT NULL, 
	approved BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (incident_id, version), 
	CHECK (version >= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(incident_id) REFERENCES incidents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(diagnosis_id) REFERENCES diagnoses (id)
)

CREATE TABLE approvals (
	plan_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	plan_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	approver_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	decision VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	rejection_reason TEXT, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (decision IN ('APPROVE', 'REJECT')), 
	CHECK (decision != 'REJECT' OR length(trim(rejection_reason)) > 0 AND rejection_reason IS NOT NULL), 
	CHECK (plan_version >= 1 AND expires_at > created_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES remediation_plans (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(approver_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE remediation_steps (
	plan_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	resource_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	parameters JSONB NOT NULL, 
	verification JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (plan_id, position), 
	CHECK (position >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES remediation_plans (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(resource_id) REFERENCES resources (id)
)

CREATE TABLE executions (
	incident_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	step_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	resource_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	status execution_status NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	pre_state JSONB NOT NULL, 
	result JSONB NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (version >= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(incident_id) REFERENCES incidents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(step_id) REFERENCES remediation_steps (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(resource_id) REFERENCES resources (id), 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
)

CREATE TABLE verification_results (
	execution_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	passed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	window_start TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	window_end TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	health_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	checks JSONB NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND window_end >= window_start), 
	FOREIGN KEY(execution_id) REFERENCES executions (id)
)
